text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Watching you lately, <nickname>-chan,
there's something I've come to realize.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"That means... cooperating with your friends
has helped you grow a whole lot!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure <nickname>-chan has already realized it,
haven't you?
—The way to get stronger♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training with our companions has yielded great results, that's for sure...
Let's ask everyone for even more cooperation!
